reviewer_notes: The layoff provision is Article Nine C (PDF pp. 16-18): C.1 lay off 'based on their seniority', C.2 classifications, C.3 'the teacher laid off shall be the teacher with the least seniority in that classification', C.4 inverse-order layoff with 'lay-off shall be determined by lottery', C.5-C.9 seniority lists, recall, 24-month recall list, and no new hires while laid-off certified teachers are available. A's quoted fragments are verbatim from PDF pages 16-17, but A reports page 15 (that is the printed footer number; footers in this PDF run one behind the PDF page), so the page is wrong. B's answer omits the governing layoff-selection rule (inverse seniority within classification, lottery tiebreak) and substitutes the involuntary-transfer clause Article Thirteen G, which is a transfer provision on PDF page 23; its stitched quote therefore spans PDF 17 and PDF 23 while reporting only page 17. Both records are unacceptable as coded data.
